drivingQuestion: What does the verse mean by juxtaposing Ahab's call with Obadiah's fear of God?
outcomeNote: the question is answered in the next unit (sanhedrin.sugya223)

segments.he: (סִימָן: קָרָא, וְזָכָה, בֶּאֱדוֹם.) כְּתִיב: ״וַיִּקְרָא אַחְאָב אֶל עֹבַדְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַבָּיִת וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָיָה יָרֵא [אֶת] ה׳ מְאֹד״. מַאי קָאָמַר קְרָא?
segments.en: § Before continuing its discussion of Ahab, the Gemara records «a mnemonic» for the forthcoming statements: «Called; and merited; of Edom.» It «is written: “And Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household; now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly”» (I Kings 18:3). The Gemara asks: «What is the verse saying?» What is the connection between Obadiah’s fear of the Lord and the call of Ahab?
